inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Elevated wide shot across four adjacent independent commercial construction sites in an East Asian city. Four different mid-rise concrete office buildings at different stages, each with its own tower crane and temporary perimeter. Cranes move slowly and concrete trucks enter different gates. Show clearly separate projects competing in the same district, no single landmark.
